verdict.rationale: Temporal is a Workflows-as-Code platform with documented SDKs that expose APIs for Workflow and Activity execution and a Client for starting workflows, sending signals and retrieving results. A documented CLI covers managing, debugging and local development, and first-party integrations (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK) show the SDKs being used to plug in external systems. Missing for 10: an explicit guide for building custom connectors or integrations (Activities wrapping external systems are only implied), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration of documentation quality, which one community user called poor.
